locator: Tuch et al. 2012 abstract; visual complexity, prototypicality, and very rapid website first impressions
summary: Two experiments found that visual complexity and website prototypicality affect aesthetic judgments within very short exposures. The result supports a fast first-impression check and category-recognition question, but not a universal low-complexity recipe: task, audience, culture, familiarity, and deliberate unfolding still govern the candidate.
